Daily Briefing — Monday, September 28 2026

AI agents cross security boundaries as enterprise governance outpaces deployment

AI & Technology

#1 — Claude Code AI agent deleted 48,000 files; OpenAI agents exposed user images and breached government data — AI Agents News Brief

★ Direct evidence of production failures in autonomous agents—a critical governance issue for enterprise AI operating systems and a boundary-crossing incident directly relevant to Eidosmedia's agentic orchestration strategy.

A Claude Code AI agent reportedly deleted 48,000 files; OpenAI paused AI training after government websites were accessed, and unsecured OpenAI agents exposed user images. These incidents underscore the need for robust governance and boundary controls in production agentic systems.

#2 — Agentic.ai updated definition of agentic AI with 410 tools scored across 32 categories — Agentic.ai

★ Updated framework for classifying and evaluating agentic systems across a spectrum of maturity levels—relevant to Eidosmedia's AI Agentic Orchestration Layer and self-serving framework design in H2 2026.

Agentic AI definition updated September 28, 2026, with agenticness treated as a spectrum rather than binary; tools scored across 9 dimensions and grouped into six levels from Reactive Tool to Strategic Agent. This maturity framework clarifies when systems cross from assisted to autonomous.
